about: Feature 022 E2E fixtures (qa T023). Every name is fictional except 'Metallica', 'Master of Puppets', 'Battery', 'Motörhead', 'Ace of Spades', 'The Beatles' and 'Guns N’ Roses' (public facts named in the spec). The suite appends a run salt (' qa<salt>') to every artist, album and song name it writes, so reruns on one data volume never share folders; expectations compare with the same salt appended. All text is self-written (CC0).

normalisation.about: Each group must end in exactly one artist folder (FR-004, FR-005, SC-002). 'display' is the spelling the folder should show (FR-011, informational; the E2E asserts the shared folder id). `{salt}` marks where the run salt goes when the normalisation drops the tail of a name (featuring parts); otherwise the salt is appended.

groups.note: FR-005: never split on '&'; 'Salt' alone is a different folder

filing.about: Tagged uploads (RIFF LIST/INFO: INAM title, IART artist, IPRD album; read by the 005 upload details) for STEMSTUDIO_FAKE_ONLINE=not-found, where the import names decide the folders (FR-003). In mode 'found' the fake match ('The Fixture Band' > 'Synthetic Sessions') wins, so the specs set track library info instead.

songs.note: research.md R-01 table: only a *matched* 'Various Artists' is ignored (FR-005); an import name is kept. The matched case is a backend unit test (the fake provider never matches Various Artists).

browse.about: Library info per track (source 'track'), so the art and counts are mode independent. 'picture' = own picture of the track (tests/fixtures/artwork, generated). Artists sort A-Z with a leading 'The' ignored; 'Unknown artist' and 'My songs' last (US2-1).

expectArt.Four Winds: mosaic of 4 (5 albums, at most 4 covers)

browse.yearNote: Album years come only from a band info match (library info has no year), so the year sort is a backend/bUnit case; the E2E sorts by name and recently added (seed order).

families.about: Search cases of SC-006 / US3-3: one query per instrument family and per detail stem group of the fake detail models (support/detail.ts fakeDetailOutcomes). The fake guitar and piano never split, so 'acoustic guitar' and piano detail groups are covered by the backend search tests only.

seed5000.about: Database fixtures for SC-003 (migration) and SC-004 (search speed), written by the backend seeder (022 T044, LibrarySeed, test category 'Seed') to the folder qa passes in: dotnet test tests/StemStudio.Api.Tests --filter Category=Seed -e STEMSTUDIO_LIBRARY_SEED_OUT=<repo>/tests/fixtures/library/db. Not committed (generated, about 10 MB each; .gitignore of this folder).
